killOutcome: On each host, the uninstrumented artifact refused with fifo/pending-unknown after SIGKILL at the intent, pending, queue rename and queue directory sync boundaries; after completed-intent archival it returned the queued ticket. All 10 synthetic child processes exited -9.
method: Copied signed fixture binaries and test-only observers over authenticated Tailscale SSH to private unique task directories. Verified each image hash after execution. Observer killed only child processes it launched, bounded by 3 CPU seconds each. No inference, real bot, existing workload or user data was modified. Initial Levi fixture failed with executable permission denied; the task-owned image was chmod 700 and the contract was rerun in a new fixture directory. Asher SSH timed out and was not used.
limits: The same diagnostic artifact on two separate Macs, each tested locally; no cross-host queue or network protocol exercised. The eight-way races do not establish arrival fairness. No power-loss, fsync failure, production runtime, trust boundary, full workload process tree, resource reservation, full governor, MTP inference or fleet qualification. Snapshot memory pressure is not reservable capacity.
